answers.core:
Godot editor isn't accessible at all with screen readers 
I tried every possible solution but I can't make it work 
I tried the editor on Windows, Linux and Android, of course with the same result
I also explored some of the possible solution from the community like 
Godot accessibility plugin
  without any luck 
mainly I’m using NVDA screen reader on windows and Orca screen reader on Linux
  as a blind person I really hope you can make Godot accessible to allow me to create my dream games.
